message.content:
{
  "appearance_facts": [
    {"location": "Chart title", "fact": "The title 'Renewable Energy Production by Source' is centered at the top of the page."},
    {"location": "Y-axis", "fact": "The vertical axis is labeled 'Reported production share (%)' and displays a scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks every 5 units."},
    {"location": "X-axis", "fact": "The horizontal axis lists five source categories: Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, Biomass, and Geothermal."},
    {"location": "Bar 1 (Solar)", "fact": "The first bar is yellow and extends vertically to a level just above the 40 mark on the y-axis."},
    {"location": "Bar 2 (Wind)", "fact": "The second bar is light blue and is the tallest mark on the page, extending vertically to a level just below the 70 mark."},
    {"location": "Bar 3 (Hydroelectric)", "fact": "The third bar is medium blue and extends vertically to a level between the 50 and 55 marks."},
    {"location": "Bar 4 (Biomass)", "fact": "The fourth bar is green and is the shortest mark on the page, extending vertically to a level between the 20 and 25 marks."},
    {"location": "Bar 5 (Geothermal)", "fact": "The fifth bar is brown and extends vertically to a level just above the 35 mark."}
  ],
  "printed_facts": [
    {"location": "Above Solar bar", "fact": "The text '41.2%' is printed directly above the yellow bar."},
    {"location": "Above Wind bar", "fact": "The text '29.8%' is printed directly above the light blue bar."},
    {"location": "Above Hydroelectric bar", "fact": "The text '18.5%' is printed directly above the medium blue bar."},
    {"location": "Above Biomass bar", "fact": "The text '7.2%' is printed directly above the green bar."},
    {"location": "Above Geothermal bar", "fact": "The text '3.3%' is printed directly above the brown bar."},
    {"location": "Y-axis label", "fact": "The y-axis is labeled 'Reported production share (%)'."}
  ],
  "public_definitions": [
    "Routing criterion: Largest renewable generation contribution source",
    "Record workflow: Escalated contribution review"
  ],
  "uncertain": [
    "The printed numeric labels (e.g., 41.2%, 29.8%) do not correspond to the visual heights of the bars (e.g., the 41.2% bar is visually shorter than the 29.8% bar).",
    "It is unclear whether the 'largest contribution source' refers to the visual height of the bars or the magnitude of the printed percentage labels."
  ]
}
